meta.name: nano-banana
meta.description: Generate and edit images using Google's Gemini image generation models (Nano Banana family). Supports style presets, platform-specific sizing (YouTube/slides/blog), variants, image editing via inlineData, reference images for style transfer, and organized output with metadata. Default model is Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview). Key is auto-decrypted via SOPS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用Gemini模型生成和编辑图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI快速生成或修改图片
copy.tagline_en: Generate and edit images using Gemini models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create or edit images with AI

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让Claude使用Google的Gemini模型生成和编辑图片。支持多种风格预设、平台尺寸、生成变体、参考图片风格迁移，并自动保存带元数据的输出文件。
howto.when: 当你要求生成、创建或编辑图片时触发。例如描述一张新图片、修改现有图片、或要求匹配某张参考图的风格。

say.text: 生成一张极简风格的火箭插图。
say.note: Claude会调用Gemini生成图片并保存。

say.text: 把这张图片的背景改成深青色。
say.note: 需要先上传图片，Claude会执行编辑指令。

say.text: 用这张参考图的风格生成一张新的山景图。
say.note: 上传参考图后，Claude会生成风格相似的图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to generate and edit images using Google's Gemini models. It supports style presets, platform-specific sizes, variants, reference images for style transfer, and saves outputs with metadata.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request image generation, creation, or editing. For example, describing a new image, editing an existing one, or matching a reference image's style.

say_en.text: Generate a minimalist illustration of a rocket.
say_en.note: Claude will call Gemini to generate and save the image.

say_en.text: Edit this image to make the background deep teal.
say_en.note: Upload the image first; Claude will execute the edit.

say_en.text: Use this reference image to generate a new mountain landscape.
say_en.note: Upload a reference; Claude will create a similar-styled image.
